statement: Community HID notes describe output 0x01 as packet-number (modulo 16), two four-byte motor words, subcommand ID and arguments; input 0x21 embeds common controller prefix then ACK byte at absolute offset 13, echoed subcommand ID at 14 and up to 35 reply-data bytes starting at 15. ACK uses high bit=1, NACK=0; low seven bits encode reply-data type; SPI read returns 0x90/0x10. OpenPuck's 0x21 emulator follows this layout for supported cases.
